content: 我们对领头 Yukawa 效应的计算涉及 Feynman 规范下的带电 Goldstone 玻色子，[[MATH_653]] 质量正是通过它进入的。人们可能会质疑，既然 Goldstone 玻色子被定义为无质量态，在这里为其引入宽度是否恰当。撇开宽度不谈，首先应该质疑的是为什么这里的 Goldstone 玻色子具有质量。关键在于，在 Feynman 规范以外的任何其他规范中，我们都必须考虑 Goldstone 玻色子和 [[MATH_654]] 交换的效应，才能导出领头 Yukawa 效应。因此，物理阈值在 Feynman 规范中得到了体现。
src:
Our calculation of the
leading Yukawa effects involves the charged Goldstone boson in the
Feynman gauge through which the [[MATH_653]] mass enters. One may question
whether it is appropriate to introduce a width here for a
Goldstone boson considering that a Goldstone is defined as a
massless state. Independently of the width one should first
question why the Goldstone has a mass here. The point is in any
other gauge than the Feynman gauge we would have had to consider
the effect of the Goldstone and [[MATH_654]] exchange to derive the leading
Yukawa effects. The physical thresholds are therefore captured in
the Feynman gauge.

other gauge than the Feynman gauge we would have had to consider

Yukawa effects. The physical thresholds are therefore captured in
the Feynman gauge.
